## Week 7 — Independent Research Project I: From Question to Pre-Analysis Plan

*Live session: Friday, August 7, 2026. Pairs with [Textbook Week 7](../book/weeks/week-07/README.md).*

| Material | Format |
|---|---|
| **Slides — interactive web deck** (with per-slide speaker notes) | [Open ▶](week-07/slides.html){target="_blank"} |
| **Slides — PowerPoint** (detailed script in each page's notes) | [Download .pptx](week-07/Week7_Slides_2026-08-07.pptx) |
| **Lesson plan** (120-minute timed agenda) | [Download PDF](week-07/Week7_Lesson_Plan_2026-08-07.pdf) |
| **Speaker script** (full read-aloud narration) | [Download PDF](week-07/Week7_Slides_Script.pdf) |
| **Homework — Pre-Analysis Plan + Identification Memo** *(due Fri Aug 14)* | [Download PDF](week-07/Week7_Homework_2026-08-07.pdf) |

**What this session teaches.** The pivot from *consuming* research to *producing* it: the so-what
filter, feasibility × novelty, the one-sentence **identifying assumption**, the threats-and-responses
table, the Olken (2015) short-form **pre-analysis plan**, the labelled primary specification,
falsification tests, and reproducible data acquisition. The homework is the **design half** of each
student's capstone paper.

*Every citation in these materials is individually verified; the anchor examples use Prof. Gao's own
published work (the Rainbow of Municipal Credit; Gao & Sun 2019, *PNAS*; Deng, Gao & Kim 2020, *JCF*).*
